'''Gubo Durab''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to [[Zelice Sturm]], a fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who lead a smuggling gang that was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. He was present in the [[Dark Edge Dancetorium]], a building that was used by Sturm as a hideout, when the [[Heroes of Cularin]] travelled there to confront the former Jedi.
